home.welcomeBody: New here? Learn everything about TBTs on the {roast}. And set up your {profile} as a creator, collector, or both — it’s used whenever you create or acquire a TBT, and it appears on the work’s page.

sections.roastNote: Roast — learn everything about TBTs: what a Transferable Billable Token is, how registration works, royalties, and verification.
sections.grindNote: Grind — the discovery floor. Browse, curate, share, and compare TBTs. (The Charts live here.)
sections.brewNote: Brew — where a creator makes a TBT: upload the work, set price and royalties, and certify it on-chain. The first TBT auto-creates “Series 1.”

espresso.title: Espresso
espresso.askImage: Let's brew this fast. Start with the piece — show me the work.
espresso.askImageHint: Take a photo now, or choose one you already have.
espresso.askScan: Next, let's check it against registered works and public sources.

espresso.askWorkHint: Speak or type freely. The title matters most; the rest can be loose.
espresso.askValue: Is this for sale — and do you want a cut of future resales? You can skip this.
espresso.reviewSub: Check it before we seal — this is what goes on the record.

brew.windowLapsed: The seal expired. Seal the work again to register it — nothing was lost.
brew.adjustPlaceholder: Tell me what to adjust — or just edit above
brew.registeredBodyFull: Your work is permanently on-chain. Your title arrives by email, and a text confirms it was sent.
brew.certKeyInside: Nothing on it is secret — keep it, print it, share it.
brew.verifyOnChainNote: Opens your record in the Solana block explorer
brew.sealBiometricNote: Seal with a single touch next time.
brew.feedPending: Not connected yet — add a line yourself if you want it on the record.
brew.tipValue: A figure is suggested so you have a starting point, but it is written into the record and the royalty terms travel with the work on every future sale — so confirm it rather than accepting it. If the work is not for sale, set the price to zero and royalties to none.
brew.tipRoyalty: A share of future resales that returns to you automatically each time the work changes hands. Choose a percentage or a fixed amount.
brew.tipProtection: Before a work is certified we compare its image against every work already registered on TBT and against public sources on the open web. A clean result strengthens your claim. If something similar exists, you decide how to declare the relationship — your own work, a derivative, or an authorised edition — and that declaration travels with the record.
brew.tipMoment: These anchors are captured automatically from your location and the world today, then written into the record of the work. Because they become part of a permanent record, read them before you continue — every line can be edited, and anything you would rather not publish can be removed.
brew.visionSub: Record a short piece about the work — it becomes part of the authenticity record.
brew.visionHint: Tap to record · up to 1 minute · audio or video
brew.imageEmptyHint: Take a photo or choose a file below
brew.tipAssetAnchors: Links to where your work lives online — a YouTube video, a Drive folder, an IPFS hash, a portfolio page. They anchor the record to the real files.
brew.tipDimensions: The size of the work in its own terms — cm or inches for physical pieces, pixels or resolution for digital, duration for time-based work.
brew.tipSeries: A series groups your own work — a body of pieces that belong together. Every work belongs to one. If you haven’t made a series yet, this one starts Series 1, which you can rename at any time.
brew.gateBody: To brew a TBT you need a Creator Profile — the identity that appears on every title.
brew.chooserSub: Two ways to register your work.
brew.espressoSub: Answer a few questions by chat or voice.
brew.imageSub: The main image that represents your work.
brew.aboutWorkPlaceholder: A few words about the piece…
brew.valueSub: Set the work's worth and how royalties are structured.
brew.royaltyPctSuffix: % of each resale goes to you

brew.protectionSub: Let's check it against registered works and public sources.
brew.scanCleanBody: {score}% similarity — well under the pass line. You're clear to continue.
brew.scanWarnBody: Found a work at {score}% similarity, over the pass line. Often fine — tell us the relationship.
brew.scanBlockBody: Your image is a {score}% match to a registered work. Certification is paused.
brew.scanPausedNotice: Registration is paused while our originality check is unavailable. Everything else works as usual.
brew.scanPausedMidBrew: We couldn’t check originality just now, so registration is paused. Please come back a little later.
brew.imageAlreadyRegistered: This image is already registered on tbt.cafe by another creator.
brew.declareOriginalSub: I'm the original creator of this work.
brew.declareDerivativeSub: This transforms or remixes existing work.
brew.declareEditionSub: A limited edition or copy of my own work.
brew.momentSub: The instant your work enters the record — where you are, and what the world looks like right now.
brew.momentHint: Auto-captured from your location and the world today · tap any line to edit it.
brew.contextSub: Written from the anchors, the details, and a reading of the image itself — so the work can be understood by anyone, even unseen, and by whatever comes to find it later.
brew.sealSub: Sealing completes your work and locks it, ready to register.
brew.chainImageLabel: The copy on the permanent record
brew.chainImageTip: The hash of your file is always recorded. This chooses whether an image goes with it. Arweave cannot be edited or deleted — by anyone, including us.
brew.chainImageNoteNone: The record names the work and proves which file it was. Nothing else is published.
brew.chainImageNoteThumbnail: A reduced copy travels with the record so it can be recognised. Your file stays with you.
brew.chainImageNoteFull: The image is published at full size and cannot be withdrawn. Location and camera data are removed first.
brew.chainImageNoteCeiling: Very large files are published as a high-quality copy under 8 MB.
brew.registerSub: Your sealed work is held for registration. Pay within the window and it's permanently on-chain.
brew.mintingSub: Registering your work to the blockchain. This takes a moment.
brew.registeredBody: "{title}" is now permanently on the blockchain.

claim.sub: This work is already registered. Tell us why it should be yours to register, and a person will read it.
claim.bodyPlaceholder: How the work came to you, when, and anything that supports it — receipts, correspondence, provenance.
claim.note: It becomes a help request you can follow in your hub. The current holder is not contacted automatically — we read it first.
claim.bodyRequired: Tell us what your claim is.

claim.sentBody: Reference {ref}. You can follow it in your help requests. We read claims in the order they arrive and reply to every one.

collector.whoSub: First, who is registering this work?
collector.madeItSub: You are the creator of this work.
collector.ownItSub: Someone else made it. You hold it.
collector.whoNote: Registering work you did not make issues a bonded title — a real title, marked on its face as resting on your word rather than the creator’s. It can be authenticated later.
collector.espressoReason: There is too much to record about someone else’s work for the fast path.
collector.creatorSub: Who made this work? You are registering it as its owner, not its maker.
collector.creatorNote: Everything on this page is your account of it, not a verified fact. That is what a bonded title records. An authentication partner can confirm it later, and the word bonded comes off when they do.
collector.unattributedLabel: No name at all — register as Unattributed
collector.namePlaceholder: As it should appear on the title
collector.aliasPlaceholder: A signature, a pseudonym, a studio name
collector.cityLivingNote: City and country only — we do not record a street address for a living creator.
collector.contactNote: Used only to reach them for authentication and their sign-off. Never published, never shown on the title.
collector.estateIntro: If there is an estate, this is who a redirected royalty could later reach.
collector.estateContactNote: Never published. Used only for authentication.
collector.credentialsPlaceholder: Shows, collections, prizes, training — whatever you know
collector.aboutPlaceholder: Anything that helps someone understand who made this.
collector.provenanceSub: Your claim to hold this work. None of it is published — it is evidence, kept private.
collector.pricePaidNote: Never published. It is not the work’s price and does not appear anywhere public.
collector.attachNote: Stored privately. Only a fingerprint of the file goes on-chain — enough to prove it existed unaltered on this date, without publishing what is in it.
collector.provenancePlaceholder: How it came to you, who had it before, anything that supports the claim.
collector.saveFailed: We couldn't save what you told us about the creator. Please try again.
